messages:
emily: Hey people-ops — tried to pick up my refill at Walgreens and they said my insurance ID doesn’t show pharmacy coverage. Card in Wallet shows 'Rx: yes'. Anyone else seen this? (Redwood Basic plan)

mike-hr: Can you DM me the member ID (or last 4) + DOB and I’ll call the carrier real quick?

emily: DM sent. Also the mobile card doesn’t display BIN/PCN/group — it only shows plan number 8902 and member ID. Pharmacy asked for BIN and PCN.

liz-benefits: Hi Emily — some carriers suppress BIN/PCN on the mobile wallet. Carrier for Redwood Basic is Northbridge Health. BIN is 012345, PCN is RBX, Group 99887.

emily: The pharmacist scanned the card and the register threw 'no Rx benefits found' then asked me to call member services. They wouldn’t accept the card or process.

liz-benefits: Ugh. If they can’t process we have two paths: 1) pharmacy can bill as cash and you submit an e-claim to Northbridge with your receipt + Rx label, or 2) we open a ticket with the carrier to push coverage flags for your member ID. We’ll also send you a temporary PDF ID with the BIN/PCN so they can key it manually.

emily: I’m traveling today and don’t really want to pay out of pocket if avoidable. Med is a daily antihistamine refill (not controlled).

mike-hr: :thumbsup: @liz-benefits can you open the carrier ticket and DM Emily the temp card PDF? If pharmacy insists on cash, we can reimburse via expense — tag benefits in Expensify with the receipt and Rx.

liz-benefits: Will do. Opening ticket now — carrier case #NB-2026-478. Filing as 'Rx benefit not showing at point of sale'. ETA carrier response 24-48h but sometimes same day. I’ll DM the temp card PDF in ~30m.

emily: Thanks! Quick Q — if I pay cash and submit, what exactly should I upload?

liz-benefits: Upload the pharmacy receipt showing date, NDC/med, qty, price; and a photo of the filled Rx label or pharmacy report. In Expensify choose 'Medical - Insurance Reimbursement' and include brief note: 'Rx paid at point of sale; awaiting carrier adjudication; attach carrier case #NB-2026-478'. We’ll reimburse the in-network allowed amount minus your copay.

emily: Got it — appreciate the fast help.

benefits-bot: Reminder — changes to BIN/PCN mappings may have propagated after 2026-01-01. If you hit this again, please file a ticket with people-ops and include the pharmacy name and error message.

liz-benefits: Filed and DM sent (temp-card.pdf). If the pharmacy still refuses, send me a photo of the register error and I’ll escalate directly to the account rep.

emily: Received the PDF, gave it to the pharmacist and they keyed it manually and it went through. Thank you both :)

liz-benefits: Great news! Closing internal case and noting carrier was slow with mobile wallet mapping. If anyone else in the office runs into this, forward this thread.
